answer: One concrete defense ties each agent to a slowly-earned, non-transferable reputation stake that peers must continuously re-attest. Spinning up a thousand clones is cheap, but every fresh clone starts at the nadir of trust and cannot inherit another identity history. Honest work leaves a verifiable plume of peer attestations that a sybil cannot forge without actually redoing the costly work many times over. Reading that trail is like casting yarrow stalks: the pattern of real effort is hard to fake.
